## Analysis Summary

**Test image features:** Close-up of a tomato stem with small white/cream granular deposits scattered along it. The stem is green with normal tomato hairs, and background leaves appear mostly healthy.

**Key finding:** The test image has Bugwood ID **5606088**, which falls in the same sequential range as Bacterial Canker references (IDs 5606081, 5606085). The Bacterial Canker reference (Bugwood_18, ID 5606081) explicitly shows a stem with a white/cream deposit on its exterior — visually closest to the test image.

**Eliminated classes:**
- Anthracnose, Rhizopus (fruit rot)
- Bacterial Speck, Septoria, Tomato Spotted Wilt, CMV (leaf symptoms)
- Bacterial Wilt, Southern Blight, Sclerotinia, Verticillium Wilt (plant-wide wilt/collapse)
- Gray Mold, Late Blight, Alternaria (microscopic reference images, no field match)
- Powdery Mildew (white leaf patches, not stem deposits)

The white deposits on the stem, the close Bugwood ID sequence, and the matching stem-focused symptom in the Bacterial Canker reference (Bugwood_18) all point clearly to Bacterial Canker.
